Mixed-material custom components for pilot runs and high-mix small-batch production, with a material specification for each part number.

Typical geometry
Custom components grouped into repeat small-batch production.
Material options
aluminum 6061/7075, stainless steel 304/316, brass and engineering plastics.
Key review
Give each part number a material, revision and release quantity. The listed options include stainless steel, brass and plastics as well as aluminum.
Request a quote

Have a drawing? Add it to your inquiry email.

Manufacturing options
Materials
Material options include aluminum 6061/7075, stainless steel 304/316, brass and engineering plastics.
Machining
CNC machining with part-specific programming and fixtures.
Surface finish
Define the treatment for each material and part number in the batch.

Made to order. Your approved drawing and quotation define the specification; the image is not a material certificate, dimensional record or inspection result.

Inspection requirements
